questions.question: If the economy fails / this year it reflect badly / on the government.
questions.solution: use 'will reflect' instead of 'reflect'. yeh ek open conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + present indefinite + future indefinite' hota hai, sentence mein economy fail hone ka result future mein reflect hoga, isliye result wala clause 'will reflect' future indefinite mein likhenge.

questions.question: Had you / not reached in time,/ we will have / lost our lives.
questions.solution: use 'would' instead of 'will'. yeh closed conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye result wale clause mein 'would have lost' ka use hoga. (had you not reached in time = if you had not reached in time)

questions.question: That man would have attacked you, if you went that way.
questions.solution: use 'had gone' instead of 'went'. yeh closed conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye yahan 'went' ki jagah 'had gone' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: I would have died if he did not dress my wound that day.
questions.solution: use 'had not dressed' instead of 'did not dress'. yeh closed conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye yahan 'did not dress' ki jagah 'had not dressed' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: If India will win this match they will win the series.
questions.solution: use 'wins' instead of 'will win'. yeh ek open conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + present indefinite + future indefinite' hota hai, sentence ke meaning ke according series future mein jitenge, isliye result wala clause mein 'will win' future indefinite mein likhenge, aur 'if' waale clause ko 'wins' present indefinite mein likhenge. Note:- 2 future tenses ek sath use nahi kiye jaate.

questions.question: If a few drops of lemon are put in the milk, it has turned sour.
questions.solution: use 'turns' instead of 'has turned'. sentence mein scientific fact ki baat ho rahi, toh scientific fact, universal truth, general truth ko present indefinite tense mein likhte hai, isliye yahan 'turns' present indefinite sahi hoga.

questions.question: If she left now, she would reach the station on time.
questions.solution: no error. Yeh 'semi closed' ka structure hai. NOTE:- Waise toh agar yeh poora sentence open conditional mein hota toh 'best' hota hai but yahan options ki wajah se 2 parts mein error mark nahi ho sakta. Yeh 'semi closed' mein aise justify kiya jaa sakta hai ki maan lo kisi ka jaane ka mann nahi hain aur wo bahana bana rahin ki ab toh late ho gaye aur aap uske baare mein keh rahe ho ki :- 'agar yeh abhi nikle toh station time pe pahuch jaaye (but wo jayegi hi toh yeh sentence open mein nahi semi closed mein likhna padega)

questions.question: If the growth of population had been controlled earlier, mankind wouldn't lived in a polluted world now.
questions.solution: use 'live' instead of 'lived'. sentence mein 'now' se pata chal raha hai ki past ke result ko present mein compare kiya jaa raha hai, jiske liye mix condition type 2 ka use hota hai, jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + would/could/might +v1' hota hai, isliye result waale clause mein 'wouldn't live' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I join a software company I am getting a good deal of experience.
questions.solution: use 'will get' instead of 'am getting'. sentence mein present ki real situation imagine karni hai jiske liye open conditional ka use hota hai jiska structure 'if + present indefinite + future indefinite' hota hai, sentence ka according usse acchi deal company join karne ke baad milegi, isliye isse 'will get' future indefinite mein likhenge.

questions.question: If I had gone to the library I can have borrowed a book.
questions.solution: use 'could' instead of 'can'. yeh closed conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye result waale clause mein 'could have borrowed' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I knew about him before I will have recommended him.
questions.solution: use 'would' instead of 'will'. sentence ke 2 parts mein toh error kar nahi sakte ki closed conditional bana de toh best solution yahi ki isse mix type-1 ke structure mein likh de. Jiska use 'past mein action ho chukka ho lekin present mein imagine kar rahe ho', jiska structure 'if + (were + noun/had+noun+v2) + would/could/might + have +v3' hota hai, isliye yahan 'would have recommended' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If so many catches had not being dropped, we could have won the match.
questions.solution: use 'been' instead of 'being'. yeh past ki closed condition hai, isme 'if' ke sath clause mein 'Had + v3' aur baad waale clause mein 'would/could/might + have + v3' mein hota hai, aur yahan 'catches drop' verb ke action ke receiver hai isliye yahan verb passive mein aayegi. Isliye 'had' ke baad verb ki 3rd form 'been' sahi hogi.

questions.question: If I was you/ I would not have / committed this mistake
questions.solution: replace 'if I was you' with 'if I were you'. kisi person ka dusra person hona unreal imagination mein likha jayega, 2 parts mein error kar nahi sakte isliye yeh mix condition type-1 ka structure banega. Jiska structure 'if + (were + noun/had+noun+v2) + would/could/might + have +v3' hota hai, isliye yahan 'if I were you' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I knew / that my friend had planned to visit the town today, / I would have made his stay comfortable.
options: that my friend had planned to visit the town today,
I would have made his stay comfortable.
questions.solution: replace 'if I knew' with 'If I had known'. sentence ke meaning ke according yeh closed conditional ka structure banega. Jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye yahan 'if I had known' sahi hoga. Note:- 'that my friend had planned' wala clause 'had known' verb ka object banega wo noun clause hai toh us se confuse na ho.

questions.question: He fell from a running train / and would have died / if the villagers did not get him admitted in the nearby hospital immediately.
options: He fell from a running train
if the villagers did not get him admitted in the nearby hospital immediately.
questions.solution: replace 'did not get' with 'had not got'. sentence ke meaning ke according yeh closed conditional ka structure banega. Isliye yahan 'had not got' sahi hoga. Note:- 'got him admitted' yeh causative verb ka receiver wala structure hai yahan 'admitted' past participle hai.

questions.question: If he would have /come here I would certainly /have taken him to the zoo.
options: have taken him to the zoo.
questions.solution: replace 'If he would have' with 'if he had'. sentence ke meaning ke according yeh closed conditional ka structure banega. Isliye yahan 'if he had come' sahi hoga.

questions.question: had you told/ me about your problems, / I would definitely help you.
questions.solution: replace 'I would definitely help' with 'I would have definitely helped'. yeh closed conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye result wale clause mein 'would have definitely helped' ka use hoga.

questions.question: If I was well /, I would go to a hill station / and have ice-cream.
options: I would go to a hill station
questions.solution: replace 'if I was well' with 'if I were well'. yeh semi closed condition sentence hai jiska use present ki aise unreal situation ko imagine karne ke liye kiya jata hai jo speaker ke according fulfil nahi ho sakti aur iska structure 'if + (v2/ were+noun/ had+noun) + (would/ could/ might) + verb' hota hai, isliye yahan 'if I were well' sahi hoga. Note:- 'c' part mein 'have' se pehle 'would' understood hai.

questions.question: If I saw you / in the market, / I would have surely met you.
options: I would have surely met you.
questions.solution: replace 'if I saw you' with 'if I had seen you'. sentence ke meaning ke according yeh closed conditional ka structure hai, isliye yahan 'If I had seen you' sahi hoga. Note:- yeh unreal imagination nahi hai isliye 'would meet (semi closed) se nahi banayenge.

questions.question: You would have/ not passed the exam /if you had not helped by Ajay.
options: if you had not helped by Ajay.
questions.solution: replace 'If you had not helped' with 'if you had not been helped'. sentence ke meaning ke according yahan passive voice ki requirement hai. Isliye yahan 'if you had not been helped' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I had known / what a greedy man you are, /I would not have asked for any help from you.
options: what a greedy man you are,
I would not have asked for any help from you.
questions.solution: no error. Note :- Yahan 'what a greedy man you are' yeh noun clause hai jo ki 'had known' verb ka object hai. Isse confuse na ho.

questions.question: If you persist in charging unfair / prices your license /will have been revoked.
options: If you persist in charging unfair
questions.solution: replace 'will have been revoked' with 'will be revoked'. sentence ke meaning ke according yeh open conditional ka structure hai. Isliye meaning ke according 'will be revoked' future indefinite sahi hoga. Note :-Yahan 'will be revoked' passive hai kyunki 'license revoke' kiye jaane ka receiver hai.

questions.question: If you were the prime / minister of India what steps/ would you have taken to remove unemployment
options: would you have taken to remove unemployment
questions.solution: replace 'would have taken' with 'would take'. yeh sentence present ki unreal imagination ko dikha raha hai isliye meaning ke according yeh semi closed ka structure banega, jiska structure 'if + (v2/ were+noun/ had+noun) + (would/ could/ might) + verb' hota hai. Isliye yahan 'would take' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I would be a /millionaire, I would not / meet people like you.
questions.solution: replace 'if I would be' with 'if I were'. yeh sentence present ki unreal imagination hai isliye meaning ke according yeh semi-closed mein jayega. Isliye yahan 'if I were be' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He behaves in such /an arrogant manner / as if he is a billionaire.
options: as if he is a billionaire
questions.solution: replace 'he is a billionaire' with 'he were a billionaire'. 'as if/ as tough' ke sath do structure follow hote hai. 'present indefinite + as if/as tough + v2' aur 'past indefinite + as if/as tough + had+v3', sentence mein 'behaves' present indefinite diya hai, 'as if' ke baad v2 'he were a billionaire' sahi hoga. aur present ki unreal imagination ke liye v2 ka use hota hai.

questions.question: I wish / I learnt swimming when / I was young.
questions.solution: replace 'learnt' with 'had learnt'. sentence mein past ki imagination karni hai aur past ki imagination karne ke liye 'had+v3' ka use hota hai. Isliye yahan 'had learnt' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I wish / he realises /that she is fooling him.
questions.solution: replace 'realises' with 'realised'. sentence mein present ki imagination karni hai aur present ki imagination karne ke liye verb ki 2nd form ka use hota hai. Isliye yahan 'realised' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If we had Mohan / in our team, we would have / easily won the match.
options: in our team, we would have
questions.solution: replace 'if we had Mohan' with 'If we had had Mohan'. yeh closed conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye yahan 'if we had had mohan' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I would realise / what you wanted , I would have / surely helped you.
options: what you wanted , I would have
questions.solution: replace 'would realise' with 'had realised'. sentence ke meaning se pata chal raha ki closed conditional ka sentence hai, isliye yahan 'I had realised' sahi hoga. Note:- 'what you wanted' wala clause 'had realised' verb ka object banega. Isse confuse na ho.

questions.question: If the freedom fighters had come back /to life they would be shocked / to see the current state of our country.
options: If the freedom fighters had come back
to life they would be shocked
to see the current state of our country
questions.solution: replace 'had come back' with 'came'. yeh sentence present ki unreal imagination ko dikha raha hai isliye meaning ke according yeh semi closed ka structure banega, jiska structure 'if + (v2/ were+noun/ had+noun) + (would/ could/ might) + verb' hota hai. Isliye yahan 'came back' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi. Note:- 'would be shocked' me 'shocked' adjective hai jo subject complement ban raha hai.

questions.question: If this ancient manuscript (a)/ gets decoded, the revelation changes the entire (b)/ understanding of how early civilizations interacted (c)/ across distant continents. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'will change' instead of 'change'. 'If' ke saath present nazar aa raha hai. 'Decoded' past participle hai. Agar yh manuscript decode ho jati hai ye matlab hai iska. 'gets decoded' 'get + v3' ka structure hai. 'gets' v1 likha hua hai. Iska matlab ye open conditional ban raha hai. Aur meaning se bhi pata chal raha hai ki ye koi unrealistic ya past ki baat nahi kar raha hai. Tho yaha open conditional lagana padega. Aur open conditional lagana hai tho If ke saath v1 likha hua hai is side me. Tho us side me hme future lgana padega. Tho 'change' nahi 'will change' hoga.

questions.question: Had Ananya not insisted on checking the pantry (a)/ cabinet once more before leaving for (b)/ the airport , the gas filled the entire kitchen. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'would have filled' instead of 'filled'. 'Had ananya not insisted' likhe ya 'If ananya had not insisted' likhe ek hi baat hai. Yani ye closed conditional ke taraf ishara kar raha hai 'had + v3' wala. Udhar 'had + v3' aa raha hai, past ki baat kar raha hai. Agar yh na hua hota tho yh ho gaya hota. Meaning se bhi pata chal raha hai ki closed conditional ka structure hai. Tho udhar 'had + v3' hai tho idhar 'would + have + v3' likhna hoga. Tho 'filled' nahi 'would have filled' likhna padega.

questions.question: The tourist couple would have (a)/ missed the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti (b)/ if their boatman not chosen the shorter route. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'had not chosen' instead of 'not chosen'. Meaning past ka hai. Agar unhone aisa na kia hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Past wala meaning hai. Closed conditional wala meaning hai. Sentence me 'would + have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai. Tho is side 'had + v3' likhna padega. Tho 'had not chosen' likhna padega.

questions.question: The neighbourhood kids would have missed (a)/ the Independence Day celebration in (b)/ the colony park if the electrician (c)/ has not repaired the faulty generator. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'had not repaired' instead of 'has not repaired'. Closed conditional wala meaning hai. Agar aisa na hua hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Sentence me 'would + have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai. Tho is side 'had not repaired' likhna padega.

questions.question: If the organisers of the Jaipur Literature Festival (a)/ will announce an additional interactive (b)/ session with author Chetan Bhagat, a large number of young (c)/ readers will rush to book the seats. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'announce' instead of 'will announce'. yeh open conditional hai. Imagination type ki baatein nahi hai. Aur baat bhi future ki kar raha hai ki agar aisa ho jaaye tho aisa ho jayega. Dono side me future hai ye bhi ishara kar raha hai. Yani open conditional me jayega. Aur 'If' ke saath future tense nahi aata hai. Isliye 'will' ko drop karna padega. Aur 'organisers' plural hai isliye 'announce' verb me koi dikkat nahi hai. Isko aap tense chapter ka rule bhi keh sakte ho ki do future ek saath nahi aate hai. Ya phir conditional ka rule bhi.

questions.question: If freshly chopped apples are left uncovered in open air (a)/ the enzymes in the fruit (b)/ react with oxygen and have turned the surface brown (c)/ which is a natural oxidation process. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'turn' instead of 'have turned'. 'are left uncovered' passive me likha hua hai. Lekin hai v1 hi. Idhar 'If' ke saath v1 hai. Aur ye koi imagination tho hai nahi aur past ki bhi koi baat nahi hai. Tho ye open conditional hai. Aur open conditional me idhar present hai tho udhar future nahi lagega. Kyunki ye fact hai. Aur fact hai tho iske andar future lagane ki jarurat nahi hai. Isko v1 ke andr hi rakhenge. 'and' laga hua hai aur udhar 'react' v1 hai tho idhar bhi v1 hi aayega. Tho 'have turned' nahi 'turn' likhna hoga. Scientific fact hai isliye v1 ke andar hi likha jayega.

questions.question: If the government had invested a decent amount on the waste (a)/ management system a decade ago, (b)/ the major metropolitan cities like Delhi (c)/ and Mumbai wouldn`t have been in such a bad situation now. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'would not be' instead of 'would not have been'. Sentence me 'had invested' likha hua hai. Yani ye closed conditional ke taraf ishara kar raha hai. Lekin closed conditional tho past ki baatein karta hai. Agar aisa hua hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Aaj ye seher itni buri situation me na hoti. 'Now' se pata chal raha hai ki present ki baat kar raha hai. Aapne shart rakhi hai past ki aur result maang rahe ho present me yani mixed conditional ban gaya. Condition past ki hai aur result present me keh rahe ho tho mixed conditional type II ka structure ban gaya. Tho is side 'had invested' hi rahega aur udhar Present ki baat karni hai tho 'would not have been' ke jagah 'would not be' likhna padega.

questions.question: If the power was not cut (a)/ by the maintenance staff ,the residents (b)/ could have watched the entire cricket match (c)/ without interruption. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'had not been cut' instead of 'was not cut'. Past ki baat hai. Agar aisa na hua hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Closed conditional ke taraf ishara kar raha hai. Sentence me 'could + have + v3' bhi vahi ishara kar raha hai. Aur dusri baat power tho kisi ko kategi nahi. Power ko kata jayega. Tho passive bhi karna padega. Tho 'had not been cut' likhna padega.

questions.question: If I was you (a)/ I would not have trusted (b)/ someone who hides important details (c)/ before taking such a big financial decision. (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'was' with 'were'. Agar mai kahu mai ban jau shahrukh khan tho possible nahi hai na. Tho koi insaan koi dusra insaan tho ho nahi sakta. Yani imagination karni thi. Tho 'If I was you' galat hai 'If I were you' hoga. Kuch bachhe soch rahe honge ki agar is side 'were' likha hua hai tho idhar 'would not trust' aana chahiye na. 'would + base form' aana chahiye. 'would not have' ye tho closed me aata hai. Tho aapko mixed conditional type I me btaye ki agar condition unrealistic ho aur baat past ki karni ho tho is side v2 wala aur is side would/could/might + have +v3 aisa structure hoga.

questions.question: If I knew that my parents (a)/ would visit my flat (b)/ I would have cleaned the (c)/ guest room and prepared everything properly. (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'If I knew' with 'If I had known'. 'that my parents would visit my flat' ye tho 'knew' verb ke object ke tarah se kaam kar raha hai. Yani is 'knew' ka jo object hai usse koi relation nahi hai. If wala structure ka 'that my parents would visit my flat' isse relation nahi hai. Ye tho know verb ke object ke tarah se kaam kar raha hai. Uska relation 'I would have cleaned.....' wale clause se hai. Agar achhe se padha hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Basically ek condition hoti hai aur ek uska result hota hai. 'my parents would visit.....' nahi. 'I would have cleaned....' Ye result hai. Meaning se pata chal raha hai ki ye koi unrealistic baat hai nahi ki semi closed me leke jau. 'would + have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai ki isko closed me le jana hai. Agar mujhe pata hota ki mere parents aayenge tho maine yh kar dia hota. closed wala meaning hai. Tho 'If I had known' likhenge.

questions.question: He slipped on the muddy village road (a)/ and would have broken his arm (b)/ if the farmers (c)/ did not take him to the nearby hospital. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'had not taken' instead of 'did not take'. 'would have broken his arm' iska matlab 'voh jaan ke tod lega apni baju' ye nahi hoga balki 'uski baju tut jati' wala meaning hoga. Closed conditional wala meaning hai. 'would + have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai. Tho yaha 'did not take' nahi 'had not taken' likhna padega.

questions.question: If my uncle would have reached our village last night (a)/ I would have taken him to the annual fair (b)/ where the whole community gathers (c)/ to celebrate the festive season. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'If my uncle had reached' instead of 'If my uncle would have reached'. Agar uncle aa jate. Condition wale part ke andar 'would + have + v3' dia hua hai jo ki galat hai. Ye tho result ka structure hota hai. Aur result ka structure 'would have taken' tho laga hua hai. Tho yaha condition wale part me error hai. aur ye koi aisi baat hai nahi ki semi closed me leke jaaye aur structure bata raha hai ki closed me leke jana padega. Tho 'If my uncle had reached' likhna padega.

questions.question: Had you informed me about your (a)/ father's sudden illness on time (b)/ I would definitely arrange (c)/ immediate transport to take him to the city hospital. (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'would definitely arrange' with 'would have definitely arranged'. 'Had you informed' likh de ya 'If you had informed' likh de ek hi baat hai. meaning bhi closed type ka hai. Agar aisa ho gaya hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Tho 'would definitely arrange' ke jagah 'would have definitely arranged' likh denge.

questions.question: If I was financially stronger right now (a)/ I would book a short trip to Kerala (b)/ and explore the peaceful backwaters (c)/ and the local food. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'If I were' instead of 'If I was'. yaha imagination ki baat ho rahi hai. 'If I was financially stronger'. 'I was' ye tho fact bata dega ki financially stronger tha. Jo ki galat hai. Agar mai hota yh wala meaning dena hai tho ye kaam 'was' nahi karta. Tho yaha 'If I were' likhna padega. Sentence me 'would book' sahi hai aur agar 'would have booked' hota tho voh bhi sahi hota. Dono ke alag alag meaning hai. Would book - Sentence me 'right now' likha hai isse pata chal raha hai ki present ki baat kar raha hai. Agar mai financially stronger hu tho mai kerala ki trip book karlu. Would have booked - Tho pahli baat 'right now' nahi aa payega aur iska meaning hoga - Agar mai financially stronger hota tho mai kerala ki trip book kar leta.

questions.question: If I saw you outside the (a)/ railway station yesterday, I would have surely (b)/ stopped my car and talked to you. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'If I saw you' with 'If I had seen you'. Unrealistic baat hai nahi ki isko semi closed me leke jaaye. 'Would + have + v3' se pata chal raha hai ki closed conditional ki taraf ishara kar raha hai. Tho 'If I had seen' likhna padega.

questions.question: You would have faced a huge fine (a)/ for late submission of your income-tax return (b)/ if you had not helped by the accountant (c)/ who completed all your documents on time.(d)
questions.solution: Replace 'had not helped' with 'had not been helped'. Yahan passive voice ki galti hai. Ye closed conditional ka structure hai. Sentence me 'would have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai, Tho is side had + v3 ka passive likhna ladega. Isliye 'had not been helped' correct hoga.

questions.question: If she had studied harder (a)/ she would be scoring (b)/ much better marks in the exam now. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'would be scoring' with 'would score'. ye mixed conditionals based questions hai. yhan condition past ki hai but result present ka hai. isliye yhan result wale part me would + v1 ayega.

questions.question: If the pharmacy keeps selling medicines without proper bills (a)/ despite several inspections, (b)/ its operating licence (c)/ will have been revoked within days. (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'will have been revoked' with 'will be revoked'. 'will have been + v3' tab use hota hai jab koi action future ke kisi specific point tak complete ho jaaye. Lekin yaha present ki baat bata raha hai iska result future me hoga, na ki future ke kisi point tak complete ho chuka hoga. Yeh open conditional hai: If + simple present, will + v1. passive mein 'will be + v3'. Isliye 'will be revoked' correct hoga.

questions.question: If you were the health minister of India (a)/ what immediate reforms (b)/ would you have implemented (c)/ to improve the condition of government hospitals? (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'would you have implemented' with 'would you implement'. yaha imagination ki baat ho rahi hai. Tho 'If you were' wale ke andar koi dikkat nahi hai. Yaha meaning aur immediate se pata chal raha hai ki ye past ki baat nahi kar raha hai. Tho ye semi closed ke andar jayega aur semi closed ke andar jayega tho 'would you have implemented' ke jagah 'would you implement' likhna padega.

questions.question: If I would be the owner of this renowned luxury hotel (a)/ chain that operates across several Indian cities, (b)/ I would not allow any staff member (c)/ to behave rudely with guests under any circumstances. (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'If I would be' with 'If I were'. Result 'I would not allow....' Ye wala part hai. Tho 'If' ke saath 'would be' wala part nahi aayega. Aur ye semi closed ke andar imagination wali baat hai. Agar mai is taj ka malik hota. Aur meaning semi closed wale structure ki taraf ishara kar raha hai. Aur idhar 'would not allow' ye bhi hint de raha hai. Tho 'would' helping verb hai. 'be' main verb hai. Tho 'be' se hi bnana padega. Tho 'If I were the owner' likhna padega.

questions.question: He keeps giving orders to everyone in the office (a)/ in such an authoritative tone (b)/ as if he is the CEO (c)/ of a multinational corporation. (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'he is the CEO' with 'he were the CEO'. 'He keeps' yani present ki baat karni hai. Aur order dene wali baat tho fact hai. Aur present ki imagination v2 se hoti hai. Tho 'He were the CEO' likhna padega.

questions.question: I wish (a)/ I understood the value of maintaining good health (b)/ when my parents repeatedly advised me (c)/ during my college days. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'had understood' instead of 'understood'. 'I wish' ke saath do structure bante hai. present ki imagination karoge tho v2 banega, aur past ki baat karoge tho 'had + v3' banega. 'kaash maine is chiz ki value ko samjha hota' yani past ki baat karni hai, tho 'I had understood' likhna padega.

questions.question: I wish (a)/ she realises how genuinely her parents care for her (b)/ instead of arguing with them (c)/ over every small issue. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'realised' instead of 'realises'. Ab yaha koi hint nahi hai ki past ki baat kar raha hai. past ki baat karne ka koi hint nahi hai. Yani present ka imagination karna hai tho v2 se karna padega. Tho 'she realised' likhna padega.

questions.question: If we had sufficient funds (a)/ in our NGO at the time of the disaster, (b)/ we could have (c)/ provided immediate relief to hundreds of affected families in the nearby villages. (d)
questions.solution: Replace 'If we had sufficient funds' with 'If we had had sufficient funds'. Agar us samay pe fund hote tho hm aur families ki madad kar sakte the. Closed conditional ki taraf ishara kar raha hai. 'could + have + v3' ye bhi hmare liye hint hai. Tho is side 'had + v3' aana chahiye tha, aur yaha akela had likha hai aur akela had tho v2 ho jayega. Jo ki galat hai. Isliye 'had had' karna padega. 'had + v3' banane ke liye.

questions.question: If our national leaders had come back (a)/ to observe the level of corruption in our country, (b)/ they would be deeply disappointed. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solution: Use 'came' instead of 'had come back'. 'would be deeply disappointed' voh disappointed honge. aisa mt sochna ki 'would be + kya aagya'. 'would + base form' hi laga hua hai. yh bas passive structure aaya hai. Ab hme pata hai ki national leader vapas zinda tho honge nahi. Jaise, agar gandhi Ji vapas zinda ho Jaye tho unko ye chiz dekh ke bhut udasi hogi. Tho waise hi agar national leader vapas aa Jaye observe karne ke liye hmare desh me corruption ko tho voh disappointed honge. Tho obvious baat hai semi closed me Jayega aur semi closed me Jayega tho v2 se bnana padega. Tho 'came back' likhna padega.

questions.question: The education commission proposed that (a)/ a uniform digital-attendance system is introduced (b)/ across all government schools (c)/ to minimise manual errors and increase transparency. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'be introduced' / 'should be introduced' instead of 'is introduced'. Education commission ne prstav dia ki ek uniform attendance system introduce kia jaaye. 'is introduced' ka mtlb tho 'introduced hai'. Jo ki galat hai. education commission ne prstav dia ki introduce kia Jaye, aur kia Jaye wala meaning tho present subjunctive mood se aayega. Tho yaha 'be introduced / should be introduced' likhna padega. kyunki present subjunctive mood me verb ki base form aati hai.

questions.question: The family prayed that the (a)/ critically injured passenger is taken to a (b)/ specialised trauma centre without delay. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'be taken' / 'should be taken' instead of 'is taken'. Family ne prathana kari ki jo critically injured passenger hai use le jaaya jaye specialised trauma hospital me, 'is taken' ka mtlb tho le jaya jata hai. Jo ki galat hai. 'le jaaya jaye' wala meaning dena hai tho 'be taken/should be taken' likhna padega.

questions.question: All the parents demanded that (a)/ the malfunctioning playground equipment was replaced quickly, (b)/ because several children had already been injured (c)/ due to its broken hinges and loose support bars. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'be replaced' / 'should be replaced' instead of 'was replaced'. Sabke sab parents ne demand kia ki playground equipments ko replace kia jaaye. 'was replace' ka matlab tho replace kar dia gaya tha. Jo ki galat hai. Yaha 'kia jaaye' wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'be replaced/should be replaced' likhna padega.

questions.question: It is imperative that every traveller carries a printed copy of the updated travel advisory, (a)/ because several checkpoints along the international border now (b)/ demand immediate proof of health clearance and itinerary details. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'carry' / 'should carry' instead of 'carries'. yeh baat obvious hai ki har koi traveller carry kare. 'Every traveller carries' iska matlab tho har traveller carry karta hai. Jo ki galat hai. ye obvious hai ki har traveller carry kare. ye 'kare' wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'carry/should carry' likhna padega.

questions.question: The dietician advised that the patient took light meals (a)/ throughout the day, since heavy portions (b)/ could slow down his digestion and interfere (c)/ with the medication schedule. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'take' / 'should take' instead of 'took'. Dietician ne advise kia ki patient light meals le. 'took' matlab usne light meals li thi. Jo ki galat hai. Usne salah di ki voh aisa kare ye wala meaning dena hai. Tho yh present subjunctive mood se aayega. Yani verb ki base form lagegi. Tho 'take/should take' likhna padega.

questions.question: I demand that he talks to the project manager (a)/ about the repeated delays, (b)/ since the team is struggling to maintain the schedule (c)/ and urgently needs clear instructions for the upcoming tasks. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'talk' / 'should talk' instead of 'talks'. Mai maang karta hu ki voh project manager se baat kare. 'He talks' ka matalb tho voh baat karta hai. Jo ki galat hai. Meaning dena hai ki voh baat kare. Voh baat kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'talk/should talk' likhna padega.

questions.question: It is suggested that students revised their previous year's notes carefully, (a)/ because many questions in the upcoming test (b)/ are expected to be based on fundamental concepts covered earlier. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'revise' / 'should revise' instead of 'revised'. Aisi salah di jati hai ki students revise kare. 'students revised' ka matlab tho students ne revise kar lia tha. Jo ki galat hai. Revise kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'revise/should revise' likhna padega.

questions.question: It is mandatory that your daughter comes to (a)/ the cultural rehearsal in formal attire, (b)/ because the final performance will be recorded (c)/ for the annual school presentation. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'come' / 'should come' instead of 'comes'. yh mandatory hai ki tumhari daughter cultural rehearsal me formal attire me aaye. 'comes' ka matlab tho aati hai. Jo ki galat hai. Mandatory hai ki tumhari daughter formal attire me aaye ye meaning dena hai. Tho 'come/should come' likhna padega.

questions.question: To maintain accuracy in the department's monthly reports, (a)/ it is necessary that every employee (b)/ does his data-entry tasks carefully, (c)/ since even minor mistakes can create major inconsistencies later. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'do' / 'should do' instead of 'does'. It is necessary ki har employee apne data entry task ko achhe se kare. 'does' ka matlab tho karta hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'do/should do' likhna padega.

questions.question: It is essential that the newly appointed investigation team (a)/ conducts a multi-stage review of the digital evidence (b)/ collected over the last six months before submitting (c)/ its findings to the national cybersecurity panel. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'conduct' instead of 'conducts'. Ye jaruri hai ki newly appointed investigation team aisa kare. 'conducts' ka matlab tho conduct karti hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'conduct/should conduct' likhna padega.

questions.question: The expert panel recommended that the pharmaceutical company (a)/ reviews all clinical reports carefully (b)/ to ensure that no adverse-reaction detail is missed (c)/ before filing for final approval. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'review' instead of 'reviews'. Expert panel ne recommend kia ki pharmaceutical company aisa kare. 'reviews' ka matlab tho review karti hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'review/should review' likhna padega.

questions.question: The High Court ordered that the state administration initiates strict disciplinary action (a)/ against officials who knowingly overlooked (b)/ repeated violations in the industrial pollution case. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'initiate' instead of 'initiates'. High court ne aadesh dia ki state administration aisa kare. 'initiates' ka matlab tho initiate karti hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'initiate/should initiate' likhna padega.

questions.question: The senior advocate insisted that the witness (a)/ gives a detailed account of the events (b)/ leading to the financial fraud (c)/ before the second hearing begins. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'give' instead of 'gives'. Senior advocate ne insist kia ki witness jo hai detailed account of events de yani detail me bataye jo jo chize huyi thi. 'gives' ka matlab tho deta hai. Jo ki galat hai. Tho 'give/should give' likhna padega.

questions.question: It is essential that someone you truly love ____ not only your words but also the silence you hide behind your smile.
questions.solution: Aisa jaruri hai ki voh samjhe. Samjhe wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'understand' likhna padega.

questions.question: It is imperative that the one you choose for life ____ your growth and hold your hand when everything falls apart.
questions.solution: Jisko tum chunte ho voh aisa kare. Kare wala meaning dena hai jo present subjunctive mood se aayega. Aur present subjunctive aayega tho verb ki base form aayegi. Tho 'support' sahi ho jayega.
